# Agent Template (Claude Code)

This repo uses the AG Kit toolkit. `.agents/` is the source of truth; `.claude/` is generated from it.
Subagents: `.claude/agents/`. Skills: `.claude/skills/`. Slash commands (`/plan`, `/commit`, `/orchestrate`, …): `.claude/commands/`.
Where rules say `.agents/skills/...`, the same skill is also installed as a native skill under `.claude/skills/`.

## Always-on rules
@.agents/rules/core-protocol.md
@.agents/rules/request-routing.md
@.agents/rules/universal-rules.md

## Memory
@.agents/memory/MEMORY.md

## Read on demand
- `.agents/rules/code-rules.md` — Apply when writing, building, refactoring, or fixing code — project-type agent routing, the Socratic Gate, Plan Mode phases, and the final checklist/scripts. Skip for pure questions or text-only responses.
- `.agents/rules/design-rules.md`
- `.agents/rules/quick-reference.md` — Apply when you need a fast lookup of which agents, skills, or validation scripts exist — for routing decisions or recalling the master/key components of the kit.
